technical.summary: Strong bullish confluence with breakout structure and volume spike, but overbought oscillators and weak ADX trend strength suggest waiting for pullback or confirmation before entry.

fundamental.summary: XOM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 86 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (17/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news sentiment limit conviction; neutral composite signal.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (397.6), flat yield curve, rising USD, and same-day FOMC event create severely unfavourable macro conditions despite distant earnings (86 days).

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + donchian 20 breakout with 15x volume spike creates textbook bullish confluence, and extreme fear (17/100) offers contrarian entry opportunity in energy sector.
debate.key_bear_argument: Stochastic and Williams %R overbought conditions, weak ADX trend confirmation, unfavourable macro (VIX crisis 397.6, same-day FOMC, rising USD), zero fundamental conviction, and price below both 50SMA and 200EMA negate technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical breakout (three white soldiers, 15x volume spike) offers contrarian appeal in extreme fear environment, but macro headwinds and overbought oscillators without trend confirmation create unfavorable risk/reward.
decision.primary_risk: Same-day FOMC event combined with VIX crisis (397.6) and rising USD create tail-risk volatility that could invalidate technical setup within hours of entry.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents show bullish signals, but risk and fundamental agents strongly oppose; debate winner (bear) reflects conflicting signals
